title: A CI script and a workflow
setup: git commit -q -m 'A small calculator with tests'

checks.name: ci.sh exists and is executable
checks.fail: Create ci.sh and run: chmod +x ci.sh

checks.name: ci.sh succeeds on the healthy project
checks.fail: ./ci.sh must exit with code 0 when everything is fine

checks.name: ci.sh prints the three stage lines in order
checks.fail: The output must contain the lines '== lint', '== test' and '== all checks passed', in that order

checks.name: ci.sh fails when a test fails
checks.cmd:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); cp -r . "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; printf 'def add(a, b):
    return a - b


def average(numbers):
    return 0
' > calc.py; ./ci.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; cd /; rm -rf "$tmp"; test "$rc" -ne 0
checks.fail: With a bug in calc.py, ./ci.sh must exit with a code other than 0

checks.name: ci.sh fails on a syntax error and does not claim success
checks.cmd: tmp=$(mktemp -d); cp -r . "$tmp"; cd "$tmp"; printf 'def broken(:\n' > extra.py; ./ci.sh > out.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -q 'all checks passed' out.txt && rc=0; cd /; rm -rf "$tmp"; test "$rc" -ne 0
checks.fail: With a file that has a syntax error, ./ci.sh must fail in the lint stage and not print 'all checks passed'

checks.name: the workflow runs on pushes and on pull requests
checks.fail: Under 'on:' list both push: and pull_request:

checks.name: the workflow has a job that runs on ubuntu-latest
checks.fail: Add jobs: with a job that has runs-on: ubuntu-latest

checks.name: the workflow checks out the code
checks.fail: The first step must be: - uses: actions/checkout@v4

checks.name: the files use spaces, not tabs
checks.fail: YAML does not allow tabs for indentation

checks.name: both files are committed
checks.fail: git add ci.sh .github and commit. The working tree must be clean.

checks.name: ci.sh is executable in Git too
checks.fail: Git must record the executable bit: chmod +x ci.sh, then commit again

hints: ci.sh starts with #!/usr/bin/env bash and set -euo pipefail. Then: echo "== lint", python3 -m py_compile *.py, echo "== test", python3 -m unittest -q, echo "== all checks passed".
Make it executable before committing: chmod +x ci.sh
The workflow: name, then on: with push: and pull_request: indented under it, then jobs: > test: > runs-on: ubuntu-latest and steps:.
The steps are a list: '- uses: actions/checkout@v4' and '- run: ./ci.sh'. Indent with spaces only.
